# MCP Blocks UI

> UI components for Claude MCP Apps. React components for Claude MCP Apps and interactive connectors, built on Claude's host tokens, display modes and mobile safe areas. Works in ChatGPT too. Distributed as a free, open-source shadcn CLI registry (MIT code; designs adapted from Anthropic's "MCP Apps for Claude" Figma kit under CC BY 4.0).

## Quick Install

Install any component into a React project. The default setup uses Tailwind CSS v4:

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://mcpblocks.dev/r/inline-card.json
```

- [Full registry manifest (JSON)](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/registry.json): Machine-readable shadcn v3 registry index of all 26 items.
- [Complete single-file LLM docs](https://mcpblocks.dev/llms-full.txt): Full documentation, usage snippets, props, tokens, and server setup in one file.
- [Agent integration guide](https://mcpblocks.dev/agents.md): Decision matrix, hard Claude MCP Apps rules, and copy-paste wiring for coding agents.

## Documentation

- [Installation](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/installation): shadcn setup for Tailwind v4, Tailwind 3.4 and standalone CSS.
- [Using with an MCP server](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/mcp-server): Register tools + `ui://` resources with `@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps` and wire `useApp` / `applyHostContext`.
- [Ship a view](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/ship-a-view): Starter app, single-file bundle, CSP, content hashes, and Claude connector testing.
- [Prepared writes](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/prepared-writes): Review proposed changes, reconcile unconfirmed writes, and report committed changes to the model.
- [Protocol hooks](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/protocol-hooks): Connect React views to the host, handle tool results, and manage prepared writes.
- [Host compatibility](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/host-compatibility): Host capabilities, verification dates, and fallbacks.
- [Composable UI parts](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/ui-parts): Build custom layouts, proposal reviews, outcomes, forms, and responsive sheets.
- [Brand your blocks](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/brand-your-blocks): Override brand accents and other app tokens while retaining the host defaults.
- [Design tokens](https://mcpblocks.dev/tokens): Complete Claude MCP Apps light/dark CSS variables and Tailwind `host-*` utilities.

## Components

- [List view](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/components/list-view.md) ([web](https://mcpblocks.dev/components/list-view), [registry](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/list-view.json)): A short list of rich rows (messages, tickets, search results) with avatars, metadata and a footer link to the rest. (inline)
- [Confirm action](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/components/confirm-action.md) ([web](https://mcpblocks.dev/components/confirm-action), [registry](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/confirm-action.json)): Confirmation for a change Claude has prepared: what will happen, who it applies to, one confirm button, and what the change includes. (inline)
- [Media player](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/components/media-player.md) ([web](https://mcpblocks.dev/components/media-player), [registry](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/media-player.json)): An inline audio card with play/pause, a waveform you can click to seek, the duration and optional regenerate/download actions. (inline)
- [Line chart](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/components/line-chart.md) ([web](https://mcpblocks.dev/components/line-chart), [registry](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/line-chart.json)): A borderless line chart with soft area fills, a hover tooltip, range tabs and a legend. Dependency-free SVG. (inline, borderless)
- [Document card](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/components/document-card.md) ([web](https://mcpblocks.dev/components/document-card), [registry](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/document-card.json)): A page or document preview with properties, lists and tasks that the user can edit in place, then hand back to Claude. (inline)
- [Carousel](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/components/carousel.md) ([web](https://mcpblocks.dev/components/carousel), [registry](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/carousel.json)): A horizontal row of comparable items with tall images, a save toggle, a rating and a meta row, with a fading edge and next button. (inline, borderless)
- [Skeleton](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/components/skeleton.md) ([web](https://mcpblocks.dev/components/skeleton), [registry](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/skeleton.json)): Loading placeholders. RowsSkeleton is the kit's loading state for lists and tables; InlineCardSkeleton and CarouselSkeleton match those components. (inline, fullscreen)
- [Inline card](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/components/inline-card.md) ([web](https://mcpblocks.dev/components/inline-card), [registry](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/inline-card.json)): A compact card for the conversation: a title, up to five data points and up to two actions. Its height always fits its content. (inline)
- [Status update](https://mcpblocks.dev/docs/components/status-update.md) ([web](https://mcpblocks.dev/components/status-update), [registry](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/status-update.json)): Confirms what happened after an action, with the host's semantic colors and one optional follow-up. (inline)

## Building Blocks

- [Host tokens](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/host-tokens.json): All design tokens from the MCP Apps for Claude kit (colors light/dark, type scale, radii, border width) as fallbacks for the CSS variables the host sends, mapped to Tailwind utilities (bg-host-bg, text-host-fg, text-host-heading-lg, rounded-host-md…).
- [Plain CSS host tokens](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/host-tokens-css.json): Light and dark host fallbacks and app token aliases as plain CSS custom properties.
- [Tailwind v3 preset](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/tailwind-v3.json): Colors, radii, typography and container queries for MCP Blocks UI on Tailwind CSS 3.4.
- [Compiled blocks stylesheet](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/blocks-css.json): Ready-to-import CSS for all shipped UI blocks with host fallbacks. Runs without Tailwind in the consuming project.
- [Host helpers](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/host.json): Apply host theme, CSS variables, fonts, display mode and safe-area insets, with dev-only guideline warnings.
- [MCP Apps protocol hooks](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/hooks.json): Connect a React view to its MCP host, read streaming tool results, call tools, and reconcile prepared writes.
- [MCP Apps fake host](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/host-harness.json): Connect views to a configurable MCP Apps bridge for Storybook and tests. Includes tool fixtures and a request recorder.
- [Host button](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/host-button.json): Button styled with host tokens, 44px tap target.
- [Icons](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/icons.json): 38 icons from the MCP Apps for Claude kit (Anthropic, CC BY 4.0) as currentColor React components.
- [Surface](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/surface.json): A card, borderless or subtle container styled with host app tokens.
- [Status pill](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/status-pill.json): A visible status label in one of five semantic tones.
- [Data list](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/data-list.json): Stacked or aligned label and value pairs using a description list.
- [Change preview](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/change-preview.json): Review individual changes before confirming a prepared write.
- [Outcome card](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/outcome-card.json): A confirmed, refused, unknown or failed outcome with one optional follow-up action.
- [Field](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/field.json): A labelled native text input or select with optional supporting text.
- [Sheet](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/sheet.json): An in-view side or bottom sheet with safe area padding and close control.
- [Branded confirm action](https://mcpblocks.dev/r/branded-confirm-action.json): A confirm action with a teal accent and a display font on the host surface.

## Optional

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/contursofran/mcpblocks): Source code, conformance checks, and example MCP server (`examples/deal-app`).
- [Live demo MCP server](https://mcpblocks.dev/mcp): Public Streamable HTTP MCP Apps server (add as a custom connector in Claude or connect from Vercel AI SDK `@ai-sdk/mcp`).
- [Planned fullscreen roadmap](https://mcpblocks.dev/#roadmap): Document editor, Cohort heatmap, Task table.
